Title: Public Preview: Azure CNI overlay Windows support in AKS

Body.Content:
Azure CNI Overlay dual-stack support for Windows nodepools in AKS is now in public preview. This new capability allows AKS clusters to support dual-stack IPv4 and IPv6 network configurations on Windows nodes, enhancing flexibility and control over network traffic within your Kubernetes environments.

Learn more.
